strategy.offer: Develops and manufactures application equipment and systems for spraying, coating, material conveying, extrusion, injection, bonding, sealing, and surface preparation, including customized system configurations.
strategy.customers: Serves industrial users worldwide needing reliable processing of paints, coatings, adhesives, sealants, cleaning media, and construction repair materials across manufacturing and infrastructure sectors.
strategy.why_we_win: Expects success through precision, reliability, durable performance under harsh conditions, high quality standards, and tailoring systems to specific customer processes and materials.
strategy.resources: Built on decades of engineering and production know-how, qualified employees, extensive product and service capabilities, strong customization skills, and near-complete in-house manufacturing.
strategy.direction: Aims to expand beyond its core region, deliver future-oriented solutions, and enable customers’ digitalized, interoperable production environments with lower implementation effort.
